cd /workspace/dev && timeout 900 python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import ctypes, json, random, resource, sys, time
ctypes.CDLL('/workspace/vendor/system-libs/libz.so.1', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/vendor'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/dev')
from stress import make_job, usize
import netnomos.pypipeline as pyp
import netnomos.nppipeline as npp

cases = [([2]*16,1,32,4,10000,64,'random'), ([65536],1,32,4,10000,64,'random'),
         ([256,256],1,32,4,10000,64,'random'), ([4]*4,2,32,4,10000,64,'random'),
         ([2]*8,2,32,4,10000,64,'random')]
tot_py = tot_np = 0.0
for sizes,K,P,w,N,Q,mode in cases:
    job = make_job(sizes,K,P,w,N,Q,mode,seed=hash((tuple(sizes),K))&0xffff)
    t=time.time(); r1=npp.compile_job(job); t1=time.time()-t
    t=time.time(); r2=pyp.compile_job(job); t2=time.time()-t
    tot_np+=t1; tot_py+=t2
    print('U=%-6d numpy %.3fs  py %.3fs  equal=%s' % (usize(sizes,K), t1, t2, r1==r2))
print('totals numpy %.2fs py %.2fs' % (tot_np, tot_py))
print('peak RSS MiB %.1f' % (resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_SELF).ru_maxrss/1024))
PYEOF
